build_dot_product_self_attention: build a DotProductSelfAttention module to compute softmax attention weights over token vectors with masking
create_sequence_aligned_attention: create a SequenceAlignedAttention module to compute attention weights between two sequences P and Q with padding masks
build_multiplicative_attention: build a MultiplicativeAttention module to compute multiplicative attention scores between a sequence and a query vector

refactor_attention_config_classes: refactor the Config classes of the three attention modules to add new hyperparameters or change defaults
